Arunachal groups report Chinese encroachment near Taksing

Civil society groups and a tribal community in Arunachal Pradesh have reported alleged encroachment by the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) in the Upper Subansiri district, near Taksing. The Nah tribe has specifically flagged the incursion onto ancestral land and is seeking government intervention. These reports highlight ongoing border concerns in the region.
